crossRefs.note: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…

translations.web: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.
translations.bsb: For the Lord GOD of Hosts will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land.
translations.kjv: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
translations.asv: For a full end, and that determined, will the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, make in the midst of all the earth.
